Here are the solutions to the math word problems:

[id 80]
Two girls each received 1/6 of 24 liters of water. So each girl received (1/6) * 24 = 4 liters.  Together they received 4 * 2 = 8 liters. Then a boy received 6 liters. Remaining water = 8 - 6 = 2 liters.
2

[id 81]
Charlie started with 10 stickers. He bought 21, so he had 10 + 21 = 31 stickers. He received 23, so he had 31 + 23 = 54 stickers. He gave away 9, so he had 54 - 9 = 45 stickers. He used 28 for cards, so he had 45 - 28 = 17 stickers.
17

[id 82]
Alex's weight is 4 * 125 - 2 = 500 - 2 = 498 pounds. Together their weight is 125 + 498 = 623 pounds.
623

[id 83]
Dan planted 3 rose bushes. Each bush has 25 roses, so he has 3 * 25 = 75 roses. Each rose has 8 thorns, so he has 75 * 8 = 600 thorns.
600

[id 84]
Let x be the number of games they won. They won 8 more games than they lost, so they lost x - 8 games. They played 22 games in total, so x + (x - 8) = 22. 2x - 8 = 22. 2x = 30. x = 15. They won 15 games.
15

[id 85]
Jim sews a quilt using one T-shirt for each vacation. He has been on 4 vacations per year for 23 years. So he has 4 * 23 = 92 T-shirts. Each T-shirt has a quilt block, so he has 92 quilt blocks.
92

[id 86]
The first alarm rang 4 times. The second rang 4 * 3 = 12 times. The third rang 12 / 2 = 6 times. Total number of rings = 4 + 12 + 6 = 22 times.
22

[id 87]
Sylvie has been with the company for 5 years. Her initial salary was $600. She gets a 10% raise every year. After 3 more years, she will have worked for 8 years. Her salary will be 600 + (8 * 0.1 * 600) = 600 + 480 = 1080.
1080

[id 88]
Let H be the number of copies Harold sold. Marilinn sold 10 * H copies. Together they sold 88000 copies, so 10H + H = 88000. 11H = 88000. H = 88000 / 11 = 8000.
8000

[id 89]
Cristina invited 16 friends. Each friend needs 0.75 gift bags, so she needs 16 * 0.75 = 12 gift bags.  Since 1/4 didn't attend, that means 3/4 did. So the number of attendees is 16 * (3/4) = 12.  Therefore she needs 12 * 0.75 = 9 gift bags.  Each bag costs $2, so she spends 9 * 2 = $18.
18
